name: cdm/legaldocumentation/common/UmbrellaAgreement
description: A class to specify a set of legal entities which are part of a legal agreement beyond the two contracting parties to that agreement. This data representation reflects the ISDA Create representation.

isApplicable.description: The determination of whether Umbrella Agreement terms are Applicable (True), or Not Applicable (False)

language.description: The language associated with the umbrella agreement, and which applies to all the parties to the umbrella agreement.

parties.description: Underlying principals to the umbrella agreement.
